attackers_goals: Attackers may leverage Slack Connect direct message invites to conduct phishing attacks by exploiting trusted communication channels with users inside the organization.
description: A user in the organization accepted a Slack Connect direct message invite from external user.
investigative_actions: Verify whether the external organization and user are known and authorized to communicate with users in the organization. Review the content of the direct message conversation for phishing indicators. Check the external user's email domain reputation. Review past Slack Connect activity from the same external organization. Follow further actions performed by the internal user's account after accepting the invite.
name: Slack Connect direct message invite was accepted
